context_selection: Per fold, equal-source-stock/date mean of three GRU seed ICs from April Q8 reports for the other four stocks only; <=1e-6 tie selects shorter context. Never use held-out Q8 score or global Q8 choice.
model_hyperparameters: Unchanged FQ2 XGBoost and hidden-64 one-layer GRU, max60/patience8, seeds7/17/29; pooled four-source training and source-only April early stopping/normalization.
heldout_boundary: Held-out Jan-Apr labels never loaded into fit/model-selection arrays. Held-out June/Sep/Nov labels only for retrospective scoring after source-only fit; same Q8 context128-eligible endpoint identities.
reporting: All five outer folds and common stock/day rows, all three seeds, training adequacy, compute, failures, null/negative results; no independent-confirmation or actual-trading claim.
